fullDescription: A two-colour ledger deck where the same pair swaps jobs partway through — saturated ground with pale ink for two slides, then the closer flips them — so the ending reads as a change of register without introducing a single new colour. A full-height column of flat vertical bars runs down one side as the structural rail, and the title word is sliced by the top edge, then by the bottom. Good for studio and workshop reports, craft-business year notes, portfolio intros and any deck that wants to look printed.
prompt:
## Resumo
A two-colour ledger deck whose two colours SWAP ground and ink roles at the closer, against a full-height flat column of vertical bars and a title sliced by the frame edge.

## Estilo Visual
Apply an inverted two-colour ledger style. Palette: clay #8E3B2A and cream #F0E7D5 — exactly two, used at 100/72/45/22% for hierarchy. Slides one and two are clay-ground; the closer is cream-ground with clay ink. Typography: 'Chivo' 900 for display at line-height 0.8 and letter-spacing -0.03em, 'Chivo' 400-700 for everything else, with corner labels uppercase at 18px and letter-spacing 0.2em. Use a NORMAL-WIDTH grotesque: an extended geometric face reads as odd rather than authored at poster scale and its roughly 1.0em advance will overflow the frame. Colour fields are FLAT.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Cover
Shelf column at the far left. Field: the title word in the heavy grotesque at about 300px pushed above the top of the frame so it is sliced by the edge, then a second word beneath it at 45% opacity. A standfirst of two lines at 30px, a short hairline, and a two-line uppercase credit. A large ghosted edition numeral at 220px and 22% opacity sits in the bottom-right corner. Corner labels bottom-left and bottom-right.

### Ledger
Shelf column repeated unchanged. Field: a display heading at 118px, a two-line lede, then five rows on a four-column grid — an oversized tabular numeral at 54px and 45% opacity, a bold 29px title, a two-line note at 19px in the 72% ink, and a right-aligned figure at 38px with a small unit suffix. Hairlines at 22% opacity above each row and below the last. Set the numeral column wide enough for the widest figure — a numeral overrunning into the title column is the failure here.

### Closer
Swap the roles: cream ground, clay ink, and restate the shelf column in clay so the same object reads inverted. A closing paragraph at 30px, a hairline, a two-line uppercase sign-off, then two display words at 300px pushed BELOW the bottom of the frame so the crop flips to the opposite edge from the cover. Move both bottom corner labels clear of the cropped type — one above it, one to the top-right — rather than letting them collide.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### The role swap — Two colours that trade ground and ink, instead of a third colour arriving.
Hold clay-ground with cream ink for the opening slides, then invert the closer completely — cream ground, clay ink, and every graphic element restated in the opposite colour. Nothing else changes: same typeface, same column, same alignment. The swap alone should carry the sense of an ending, which is why no new hue is needed and why adding one would waste it.

### The shelf column — A full-height flat colour-block field acting as the structural rail.
An inline SVG about 320px wide and full height with preserveAspectRatio none, holding four flat vertical bars of differing widths at 0.9, 0.42, 0.2 and 0.62 opacity, separated by narrow gaps of the ground showing through — a shelf of spines seen edge-on. A few short horizontal rules in the opposite colour sit across two of the bars at different heights, like bands on a binding. Repeat it identically on every slide and restate it in inverted colour on the closer. It is structure, so give it no border, no shadow and no rounding.
